guideline: choose server and client boundary intentionally
do: keep client components narrow when browser state is needed
dont: mark entire route tree use client

guideline: co-locate data fetching with ownership and cache semantics
dont: assume cache behavior from framework version

do: provide dimensions sizes and meaningful alt text

guideline: model route loading and error states explicitly
do: use route-level loading and error when meaningful
dont: duplicate spinner logic in every component

do: prefer server rendering for static or data presentation
dont: import heavy client libraries for decoration

guideline: treat title description and social metadata as product surface
dont: use generic metadata on every page

guideline: keep server action or API validation authoritative
do: show pending and field errors near control

guideline: stream only when partial content is useful
do: keep skeleton geometry aligned with final content
dont: add streaming to hide slow ownership
